title: 2-Million-Year-Old DNA Revealed an Extinct Giant
description:
How do you find a mastodon without finding its body?

In northern Greenland, scientists recovered environmental DNA from sediment about two million years old. The fragments revealed evidence of mastodons and a vanished ecosystem—not a resurrected animal or a complete genome.

For the full investigation, tap the related video below the channel name.

Visuals: stylized 3D scientific illustrations, not actual ancient footage. AI-generated narration.

Research: Kjær et al., Nature (2022), “A 2-million-year-old ecosystem in Greenland uncovered by environmental DNA.”
DOI: 10.1038/s41586-022-05453-y

#AncientDNA #Mastodon #Shorts
